query: Is ISI mark mandatory for concrete as per IS 456?
expected_answer: No. IS 456 is a code of practice, not a product standard. No Scheme-I licence exists for 'concrete'.

query: Difference between Fe500 and Fe500D under IS 1786:2008
expected_answer: Both have min YS 500 MPa. Fe500D requires higher elongation (≥16%) and higher TS/YS ratio; mandatory for seismic ductile detailing.

query: Does IS 13252 Part 1 require ISI Mark or CRS R-number?
expected_answer: CRS R-number. It is under Compulsory Registration Scheme, not Scheme-I.

query: Which standard for lithium-ion power bank cells?
expected_answer: IS 16046 (Part 2):2018 under CRS. Part 1 is for nickel systems only.

query: Is hallmarking the same as ISI mark for gold jewellery?
expected_answer: No. Hallmarking under IS 1417 is a distinct scheme operated through Assaying & Hallmarking Centres; it is not Scheme-I factory licence.

query: Can I still use IS 302 (Part 1):2008 for new appliance registrations?
expected_answer: Transition period exists under successive QCOs; new registrations should target IS 302 (Part 1):2024. Check current concurrent-running end date.

query: IS 2190 or IS 15683 for portable fire extinguisher product compliance?
expected_answer: IS 15683:2018 is the product specification. IS 2190:2010 is the code of practice for selection/installation/maintenance.

query: Is IS 10500 a product standard that requires ISI mark on drinking water?
expected_answer: No. IS 10500 is a water quality specification. Packaged drinking water has separate standards and certification routes.

query: What is the correct standard and scheme for two-wheeler helmets?
expected_answer: IS 4151:2015 under Scheme-I (ISI Mark + CM/L). Mandatory since 1 June 2021. Include amendments.

query: Structural steel plate — IS 2062 which year and grade for seismic zone?
expected_answer: Current edition IS 2062:2011. Specify grade (e.g. E350) AND quality class (BR or C for impact). Old Fe-nomenclature should be mapped.
